messages:
micah: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we extract the "edge interface" (ingest/routing/authn) out of session-controller into a small, purpose-built edge service. Goals: clearer module boundaries, easier canarying, and incremental tech-debt paydown.

micah: High-level plan: 1) add an edge facade in front of session-controller, 2) mirror traffic (dark) to new edge, 3) iterate and optimize, 4) canary, 5) cutover + deprecate old handlers.

anya: +1 on facading first. we should version the contract from day 0 (v1/v2) and bake in explicit compatibility checks. protobuf/gRPC gives stronger guarantees but extra infra.

devin: FWIW, ops loves HTTP/JSON for easier routing and retries. if we use gRPC, we'll need envoy route configs and more smoke tests. tradeoff: telemetry + contract strictness vs operational simplicity.

micah: exactly. tradeoffs noted. proposed compromise: internal gRPC for edge->downstream, expose HTTP+JSON to external callers. keeps strong typing internally and lowers integration work for clients.

sanjay: latency concern — moving auth checks earlier might add extra RTTs. can we co-locate auth cache with edge instance to avoid a hop? also cache invalidation semantics need spec.

micah: good call. plan to include local LRU+stale-while-revalidate K/V cache in edge. we'll document eviction, TTL, and invalidation hooks in the RFC.

anya: tests we need: contract conformance test suite, chaos tests (partial failures to downstream), perf baseline (+/- 95th p99 targets), load soak for KV cache behavior.

devin: rollout strategy detail: dark traffic for 2 weeks with 10% mirrored qps -> watch error rates, latencies, tokenization differences. then 1% live canary, 10% for 24h, 50% for 48h, cutover. automate rollback on SLO breach.

micah: added: circuit-breakers + fallback path to route to legacy handlers on regressions. also, telemetry: per-route latency, CPU, mem, cache hit/miss, token cost delta.

rfc-bot: RFC created — https://rfc.internal/repo/edge-interface-extract. assigns: micah (owner), anya (contracts), devin (infra), sanjay (perf).

anya: propose a deprecation window of 90 days post-cutover, plus a final 'kill-switch' flag guarded by ops. include migration docs for teams that integrated directly with session-controller internals.

ops-oncall: ops asks for runbook snippets now: how to switch traffic, how to force fallback, how to inspect cache state. please add to runbooks before canary. :clipboard:

micah: will add runbook + emergency rollback play. also scheduling a 45min sync next Wed to walk through the RFC and attach perf numbers. @anya @devin @sanjay can you make it?

devin: I'm in.

anya: yes.

sanjay: yes but would like local perf spike tests before the meeting — will dump numbers to the RFC by EOD Monday.

micah: sweet. action items: micah write facade spike + deployable image (P0), anya draft contract schema + conformance tests (P1), devin prepare envoy/gw routing config template + smoke infra (P1), sanjay perf soak plan + metrics (P1), ops-oncall runbook skeleton (P2).

micah: one more thing — let's try to make the edge tiny: no heavy business logic. if we find logic creeping in, that's a tech-debt smell and should go into a clear separate service.

devin: agree. keep it thin and composable.

micah: thanks y'all. I'll post the updated RFC with the plan and timeline tonight. please add comments on the doc rather than here to keep this thread for sync notes. :sparkles:
